top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a game-changing, simply stated principle, induced proximity via bifunctional degraders and cereblon-directed glues, backed by quantitative ternary-complex and kinetic evidence reproduced by independent groups, with consequences already shown by approved glue drugs. The three-name allocation (Crews and Deshaies for the concept, Handa for the cereblon mechanism) is defensible if the citation is held to concept and mechanism, though Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto and others are left out and no PROTAC is yet approved. P002 is the safest fallback on maturity and attribution but is a refinement of the 2010 coupling prize. P004 has undisputed impact but no clean three-person cut. P003 is sound but narrow, and a prize is still preferable to none.
